name: Pre Matric Scholarship for SC students- DNH & DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu
benefit: 1. Financial support for SC students studying in Std. IX and X. 1. ₹3,500/- per annum assistance for day scholars. 1. ₹7,000/- per annum assistance for hostellers. 1. Additional 10% allowance for Divyang students. 1. Encourages continuation of education among economically weaker students.

all.value: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should belong to the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. 1. The applicant should be studying in Class IX or Class X. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant's parents' or guardian's annual income from all sources should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. 1. The applicant should possess a UT domicile certificate. 1. The applicant must study in a recognised school with a valid UDISE code. 1. The applicant must be divyang students are eligible for an additional 10% allowance.
